scope: Additive TH18 Furnace and required Firemite data baseline. Its source-supported stationary and child-spawning identity is recorded, but no spawn cadence, self-decay or fire geometry is approximated in Core.
game_version: The inherited level payload is source commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. A September 2026 secondary table identifies client build 18.600.3 for the current Furnace parent values. Firemite mechanics are current secondary observations without a published client build.

sources.title: Welcome to Clash Anytime Update!
sources.limitations: Establishes a stationary Dark Elixir troop that unleashes Firemites which target and burn Buildings, unlocked at Dark Barracks 12 and Town Hall 15. It does not publish level tables, spawn cadence, parent decay, Firemite combat numbers, flame geometry, or target retargeting.

sources.title: Furnace
sources.version: client build 18.600.3, as reported by publisher
sources.limitations: Provides current parent HP, L1-L4 availability, housing, no movement, ground-and-air target metadata, 0.8-second card cadence and melee range. It does not provide the Furnace spawn schedule, self-damage rate, Firemite data, flame radius, or lifecycle implementation.

sources.title: Furnace
sources.limitations: Provides 60-second lifetime and level-dependent maximum spawned counts of 19, 20, 21 and 22. It describes interval-based spawning and parent self-decay but gives no exact tick schedule or decay values.

sources.title: Furnace/Firemite
sources.limitations: Provides current L1-L4 Firemite hitpoints, direct damage, maximum flame DPS, speed, 2.5-tile range, 10-second flame duration and ground-and-air area damage. It omits attack cadence, flame radius, pulse cadence, target selection and precise source build.

spawned_units.note: Indexed by Furnace L1-L4. Spawn cadence is intentionally absent.

support.note: Core keeps no fabricated timed spawning, self-decay, flame, or retargeting behavior until exact future-affecting values are sourced.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued L1-L4 stationary parent without a versioned lifecycle or required child inventory.
changed_values.replacement: L1-L4 parent data is paired with source-backed stationary, 60-second and maximum-child metadata.
changed_values.justification: The official announcement establishes the parent and Firemite relationship. Current counts and lifetime are explicitly secondary, so no cadence or damage model is inferred.

changed_values.previous_state: Required Furnace child absent from the normalized catalogue and permanent scope.
changed_values.replacement: L1-L4 Firemite data is preserved as a catalogued-only spawned unit.
changed_values.justification: The secondary table supplies the values but not a sufficient deterministic spawning and persistent-flame contract for Core behavior.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source publishes the exact Firemite spawn timestamps, initial delay, parent self-damage rate or order when damage, healing, Freeze and a scheduled spawn coincide. A 60-second duration divided by the maximum count is not an exact cadence and is not used as one.

No consulted source publishes Firemite flame radius, target occupancy or refresh rule, damage pulse interval, overlap rule in a deterministic form, flight time, collision, target loss, or deterministic fallback from Buildings to combatants.

The September 2026 parent table is build-pinned by a secondary publisher. Firemite values and mechanics are unversioned current secondary observations. The October 2025 defensive-Furnace balance note is outside this goal because Clan Castle reinforcement content is excluded.
Source-verified Firemite and Furnace sprite placement, scaling and animation are unavailable. Neither item is reported as visually conformant.
conclusion: Furnace L1-L4 and Firemite L1-L4 data is inventory-visible with provenance. Parent and child behavior remains disabled rather than approximated until an exact deterministic schedule and persistent-flame contract is available.
